steps.content: Stomp, stomp, stomp—you're running at top speed, passing by constantly worsening contamination and lingering Corruptors, climbing up the metal staircase as fast as possible.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If I remember correctly, this bald statue is more than a hundred meters tall, which means we have to climb at least thirty to forty levels.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If we go on like this, by the time we reach Zoya, we won't have any strength left to fight her.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, are you alright? Your stamina...

options: Don't worry, I can go on

steps.content: In fact, you don't feel tired at all. It's as if your determination to fight has really transformed into strength, granting you immunity against exhaustion.
This is not the first occurrence of this kind of bizarre phenomenon. The laws within the Black Ring are influenced by human will, so there are obviously slight deviations in the everyday rules.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: We must believe we can get there sooner

steps.content: Through the shackles connected to Zoya's mind, you can perhaps interfere in this realm too. You're not certain about it, but it's worth a try.
At the same time, your hunches, your sixth sense, and your clairvoyance have also been significantly amplified. It's as if a voice keeps nagging you:
Hurry up, you must hurry up, or you won't be able to make it...
A deep howl shakes the whole statue from top to bottom, then shocks the entire Black Ring from the inside out.
At the top of the statue, the white light that's been resisting the limbo suddenly disappears.

The power suppressing the Black Ring has disappeared. Inside the statue, it feels like some kind of seal has been removed, or a spell has been lifted. All the dazed Corruptors suddenly snap out of their confusion and turn to look at you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Oops. That chick above there drawing all the attention, she's collapsed?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Careful, Chief... The Corruptors are coming at us now!
